highlight.title: The Madame Blanc Mysteries — Season 5
highlight.badge: Acorn TV Original · Season 5 · Premieres November 9
highlight.description: Sally Lindsay returns as antiques expert Jean White, juggling fresh murders and stolen treasures as her wedding to Dom (Steve Edge) approaches, with new episodes weekly through a December finale.

new_arrivals.title: A Remarkable Place to Die
new_arrivals.description: Chelsie Preston Crayford returns as Detective Anaís Mallory, back in New Zealand to lead homicide cases while an unsolved mystery from her own past resurfaces. Rebecca Gibney joins as Mallory's estranged mother.

new_arrivals.title: Still Life: A Three Pines Mystery
new_arrivals.description: Nathaniel Parker stars as Chief Inspector Armand Gamache in this adaptation of Louise Penny's novel, investigating whether a village death during Thanksgiving was really a hunting accident.

new_arrivals.title: This Is Not a Murder Mystery
new_arrivals.badge: Acorn TV Original · Finale in November
new_arrivals.description: A young Salvador Dalí and René Magritte are among the Surrealist artists reunited at a lavish English country estate in the 1930s, only to find themselves trapped there with a serial killer on the loose.

new_arrivals.title: The Red King
new_arrivals.badge: New to Acorn TV · Finale in November
new_arrivals.description: Anjli Mohindra stars as DS Grace Narayan, posted to a remote Welsh island where a missing boy's case leads to a pagan cult the locals insist no longer exists.

originals.title: The Chelsea Detective
originals.description: Adrian Scarborough stars as a rumpled, sharp-eyed detective solving murders in one of London's wealthiest neighborhoods — a genuine Acorn TV Original with real bite beneath its polished setting.

originals.title: The Madame Blanc Mysteries
originals.description: Sally Lindsay stars as an antiques expert turned amateur sleuth after relocating to the south of France — a cozy Acorn TV Original now in its fifth season.

originals.title: Signora Volpe
originals.description: Emilia Fox stars as a disillusioned former MI6 operative who settles into a quiet new life in the Umbrian countryside, only to keep stumbling into local mysteries — an Acorn TV Original produced by Route 24.

originals.title: Art Detectives
originals.description: DI Mick Palmer (Stephen Moyer) and DC Shazia Malik solve murders connected to the world of art and antiques, from Old Master paintings to Banksy street art.

originals.title: Dalgliesh
originals.description: Bertie Carvel stars as P.D. James's enigmatic poet-detective in this atmospheric Acorn TV Original, based on the bestselling Adam Dalgliesh mystery novels.
